spine: Compare a source with its polished transformation, identify consequential losses, and test whether the proposed category adds explanatory value.
art: An editorial transformation: a true main claim remains while the affected person, deadline and alternative are physically removed; a source comparison restores inspectable consequences.
lines: The Smoothing examines how truthful language can still hide decision-relevant consequences.
Its central question is what disappears when a message becomes easier to accept.
The book compares source and output through actors, uncertainty, alternatives, and affected people.
It treats smoothing as a research hypothesis, including useful simplification and harmful attenuation.
Readers learn to question apparent completeness without demanding that every text preserve every detail.
